policy: No suite here is independent validation: all were written by the engine's developer. A frozen suite's sha256 must not change; its first_run is the only blind result. An independent holdout needs an author who did not write or read the engine, and must be committed (with its hash here) before its first run; see evals/semantic/INDEPENDENT_HOLDOUT.md.
